name: The Stone of the Tides
summary: Following rumours of a haunted isle off the jungle coast, Baron Revilgaz suspects an ancient troll relic has resurfaced. He directs explorers to scout the mysterious landmass and delivers a pass to research the artifact within the archives of Stormwind.

sections.title: A Magnate's Ambition
sections.body: Having learned of strange apparitions and water elementals haunting an offshore island in Stranglethorn Vale, Baron Revilgaz sees an opportunity. Suspecting that the goblin mage Gazban may have uncovered the fabled Stone of the Tides, the ruler of Booty Bay sends you to locate the island and confirm whether the rumors are true. To satisfy any curiosity about the relic, he provides a library scrip redeemable among the scholars in Stormwind.

sections.title: An Ancient Ward
sections.body: Confirming the unnatural presence on the isle confirms the baron's highest hopes: the legendary artifact is real. Yet claiming it will not be simple. The Stone of the Tides carries a potent magical curse that Revilgaz recognizes he cannot break alone, requiring the expertise of an experienced wizard before any recovery can begin.

faq.q: Who asks you to locate the haunted island?
aliases: quest giver stone of the tides
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz, leader of Booty Bay, sends you after hearing tales of strange activity off the coast.

faq.q: Where is the haunted island located?
faq.answer: The island lies off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, an island out at sea that you will have to find yourself.

faq.q: What is the Stone of the Tides?
aliases: what is stone of the tides
faq.answer: It is a legendary troll artifact that Revilgaz hopes to add to his collection, a legend he first came across in an old book.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz want the artifact?
faq.answer: The baron seeks to claim the powerful troll relic to add it to his extensive collection of ancient artifacts and relics.

faq.q: What is the Library Scrip used for?
aliases: where do i take the scrip
faq.answer: The scrip can be brought to Donyal Tovald at the Stormwind Library to obtain a copy of the book in which the baron first read of the legend.

faq.q: What was the previous step in this chain?
faq.answer: This investigation directly follows The Haunted Isle, which first brought word of the unusual sightings to the baron.
